stills: login-still-desktop.webp and login-still-mobile.webp were recaptured on 2026-09-27 from this project's WebGL scene using the 26-block Blender MCP glass-material GLB, the revised water reflection, and night atmosphere 08. The real login card and HTML slogan were hidden during capture, so neither is baked into the images. Reproduction and WebP conversion: output/water-light-20260927/capture_stills.mjs and convert_stills.py.
brand_colors: Official ISU CI RGB palette from https://www.isu.co.kr/kor/prcenter/ci.jsp and its downloadable isu_ci_pdf.pdf: Blue #008FD4, Green #99CA3C, Gold #B4985A, Silver #A7A9AC, Light Gray #E5E4E0. The 3D logo and HTML slogans use the Blue and Green base values; scene lighting, translucency, hover highlights, and the darker button shade affect displayed pixels.
water_scene: apps/web/app/login/isu-water-scene.ts uses the authored Blender block model and its embedded blue-glass material, with local Three.js water reflection and a softly blurred procedural studio reflection for blue blocks. Pointer motion creates a directional reflection wake, and a local point light briefly highlights the selected block. The six atmosphere states now follow dawn, blue daylight, sunset, lavender afterglow, rainy evening, and night, holding each for 15 seconds with a 5-second transition. The sun moves over the horizon and casts a broken light path across the water. Unseen Studio was inspected as a visual reference, with no external code or assets included. The three files in Downloads/참고이미지 were used for water, sun, and horizon visual guidance only; no pixels were copied into the app. The separate HTML slogan uses the local Geist font and an in-text pointer sheen.
